identity: From: David Hughes Insurance <BREVO_SENDER> · Sign all: - David Hughes, David Hughes Insurance
compliance_note: B2B outreach to business decision-makers (owners/presidents of commercial operations). Email-only — no AI-voice cold call until engagement. Unsubscribe handled via Brevo webhook + DNC.

steps.subject: Quick question about {company}'s commercial auto renewal
steps.body: {first_name} - I'm David Hughes, an independent commercial insurance agent licensed in {state}. I work with {industry} operations on one thing: making sure they're not overpaying on commercial auto and liability at renewal. I quote across multiple carriers (Cover Whale, Nirvana, Forge, RT Connector and others) so you see the real spread - not just one company's number. No pitch in this email. Just a question: when does {company}'s current policy renew? Reply with the month and I'll tell you in one line whether it's worth a comparison. - David Hughes, David Hughes Insurance

steps.subject: The gap I see most in {state} {industry} policies
steps.body: {first_name} - quick one. Most {industry} operations I quote in {state} have the same blind spot: the auto policy is fine, but the liability limits were set years ago when the business was smaller. One bad accident with today's equipment and payroll and the policy runs out before the lawyers do. Takes me 4 minutes to check your limits against what carriers are writing for your size operation right now. Worth a look? Reply YES and I'll send a one-page comparison - no call needed unless you want one. - David Hughes, David Hughes Insurance

steps.subject: Why a comparison quote costs you nothing
steps.body: {first_name} - transparency: I'm compensated by the carriers, not by you. I'm independent - not captive to one company - so when I quote, you see the line items from multiple carriers side by side. If your current policy is already the best deal, I'll tell you that too and you keep it with my blessing. If it's not, you switch at renewal with zero lapse. Either way you know. 10 minutes here if you want the comparison: {booking_link} - David Hughes, David Hughes Insurance

steps.subject: Closing your file
steps.body: {first_name} - I don't chase people. If commercial insurance isn't on your radar right now, no problem - this is my last note. When renewal comes around, one reply reopens everything and I'll have the comparison ready in a day. If you'd rather not hear from me at all, reply STOP and you're off the list instantly. - David Hughes, David Hughes Insurance
